verification_gate: VERIFIED + detected + confidence>=0.9 -> AUTO_REMEDIATE; else detected -> HUMAN_REVIEW; else MONITOR_ONLY. With template reasoning every alert is VERIFIED at 1.0, so this auto-remediates everything (strawman).
random: Python random.Random(seed), one draw per held-out alert
best_constant: Action with the best mean reward on the fold's training alerts (AUTO safety mask per alert)
supervised: Logistic regression P(attack) on the 6 non-constant context features (training folds), action with the best expected reward under the table, AUTO safety mask
score_tier: Up to 3 normalized-score tiers, cut points from training quantiles 0.05..0.95, each tier's best training action; pair with the best training mean (AUTO safety mask)
